description: Installation of roof windows to allow for the conversion of part of the loft into a habitable room of the flat
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (2020064/92/A & proposed separating floor insulation specification received 20 October 2020; 2020064/97/A & /98A  received 30 September 2020; 2020064/91, /93, /94, /95 & /96 received 24 August 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the information provided in this application, before the additional accommodation hereby approved is first occupied, the developer shall obtain and provide to the local planning authority for its records a copy of the necessary certification to demonstrate that the development has been tested and shown to comply with Approved Document E of the Building Regulations 2010 as amended in 2015 or any successor provisions that may come into force.
